contentStandards: Explain relevant tuition and additional fee components.
Identify the applicable institution, programme, campus, intake, student category, and academic year where relevant.
Distinguish official fee information from general estimates.
Include living costs, accommodation, and other expenses only where relevant.
Explain applicable scholarship, financial aid, and loan conditions using verified sources.
Clarify refund, cancellation, deposit, and payment terms using official policies.
Include official source links and the last verification date.
Do not invent fees, refund guarantees, eligibility rules, or financial terms.
publishingChecklist: Verify fee information against current official sources.
Identify the applicable academic year and programme.
Clearly label estimates and distinguish them from official amounts.
Check currency, payment period, deposits, and additional charges.
Verify scholarship, loan, refund, and cancellation information.
Test all links and review PDF readability and printing.
Check document metadata, accessibility, and page layout.
Remove personal financial records and confidential applicant information.
Confirm the deployed file exists before publishing its download link.
